reading: The weight term is compute-bound, not bandwidth-bound: one traversal streams 496 MB for Llama in 252-345 ms (1.5-2.1 GB/s) and 446 MB for Qwen3 in 127 ms (3.7 GB/s); the batched GEMV dequant arithmetic, not the memory system, is what the weight term pays for.

Attention becomes the larger term far earlier than the serve-surface numbers suggested: crossover 266 for Qwen3 (kvDim 1024 over 28 layers) and 555-827 for Llama (kvDim 1024 over 16 layers). At 2048 tokens on Llama, attention is 110 s against 44 s of weight reads.
Batching already removed the weight term's growth with prompt length; the batched curve now degrades with length only because of the attention term.
